full_judgment: 2. The petitioners as plaintiffs, filed the above other suit No. 3 of 1979 against the opposite party no. 1 Nur Khatun and her mother Mallika Khatoon for recovery of Khas possession of the Suit land after evicting the defendants there from. The case of the plaintiffs in short is that 2.29 acres of land of C.S. Khatian No. 818 corresponding R.S. Khatian No. 1599 of Mouza Bakali as described in schedule 1 to the plaint originally belonged to Md. Naki and Asad Ali. Md. Naki died leaving three sons namely Abdul Mazid, Abdus Subhan and Abdul Hakim. Abdul Hakim thereafter died leaving behind his brothers, a widow and a daughter. That the interest of Abdul Hakim in the Suit land along with other lands was auction purchased by one Abdus Samad in S.Q.C Execution No. 923 of 1922 of the 1st Munsif Court Sadar Chittagong and the said auction purchaser get sale certificate and delivery possession of through Court. The said auction purchaser then sold the suit land to the plaintiff and his three brothers by registered kabala dated 23.10.1926. The name of plaintiff and his said 3 brothers were correctly recorded in the R.S. Khatian. That Abdul Majid another son of Md. Naki died leaving son Sidique Ahmed as only heir. Siddique Ahmed was in Burma during R.S. operation and as such Abdus Sobhan the other son of Md. Naki fraudulently got the remaining entire land recorded in his own name excluding the name of Siddiq Ahmed but such wrong recording could not affect the title of Siddique Ahmed. That Siddique Ahmed while in possession died leaving a widow Ashafa Khatoon and Surma Khatoon sold their share to Sayera Khatoon by registered Kabala dated 3.1.1943. Saira Khatoon later transferred her entire share including her purchased land to the plaintiff by Kabala dated 7.5.1941.
